_comment: Owner waivers for the release gate (D-860, scripts/ci/release-gate-core.mjs). Only the conditions in WAIVABLE can be waived (today: staging-e2e-day). A waiver lasts at most 14 days from decidedOn. An expired, malformed or unknown entry is ignored and the condition is judged normally. Keep reason and followUp free of links.

waivers.reason: V2 release: staging has never run a full day (staging Worker cron off, staging WORKER_HMAC_SECRET not set); Owner chose to release on the other gates and watch production's first nights
waivers.followUp: Set up a staging test day: staging cron test window, WORKER_HMAC_SECRET on Vercel staging, staging slots listed; run the Staging E2E day before the next release
